_doc: FireRed/LeafGreen Route 3 land_mons (pret src/data/wild_encounters.json sRoute3_FireRed): Pidgey/Spearow/Rattata-class field grass plus Mankey and the Nidorans, with Jigglypuff the rare slot. 12 FRLG slots (20/20/10/10/10/10/5/5/4/4/1/1) aggregated by species: Spearow 6-8 (35), Pidgey 6-7 (30), Mankey 7 (10), Nidoran M 6-7 (14), Nidoran F 6 (1, FRLG's FireRed rare Nidoran; LeafGreen makes it common and Nidoran M the rare one) and Jigglypuff 3-7 (10, the rare one). rate 20 = FRLG land_mons.encounter_rate.
